mono-20001.d: A jellyfish hangs in open water, its domed bell trailing frilled arms and a curtain of beaded tentacles. It has managed for five hundred million years without a brain, which is more than can be said for most of us.
mono-20001.t: A single jellyfish in side view: domed bell with radiating lines, frilled oral arms and long trailing tentacles

mono-20002.d: A sea turtle glides past with its front flippers spread, every scale and shell plate drawn in fine engraved line. It has been doing this for a hundred million years and sees no reason to hurry now.
mono-20002.t: A sea turtle swimming, seen from above at a slight angle: head, plated shell and two front flippers

mono-20003.d: A barn owl sits upright on a dead branch, its pale facial disc turned straight towards you. It has clearly already decided whether you are worth eating.
mono-20003.t: A barn owl perched on a bare branch, facing the viewer

mono-20004.d: Three granite towers rise above a scree valley and a glacial lake, after the Torres del Paine in Chilean Patagonia. They have stood there for some twelve million years and are in no hurry to be anywhere else.

mono-20005.d: An old wind-bent pine grows alone from a rocky ledge above a calm bay, with headlands on either side. It has chosen the view over the soil, and seems content with the bargain.

mono-20006.d: A slender stone lighthouse and its keeper's cottage stand on a rocky headland while the swell breaks white on the rocks below. It has been keeping the lights on for longer than most utilities.
mono-20006.t: A tall round stone lighthouse with its keeper's cottage on a rocky headland, Atlantic waves breaking below

mono-20007.d: A coiled shell winds in on itself in ribbed whorls, each turn a little smaller than the last. Its owner built it one chamber at a time and never once needed planning permission.
mono-20007.t: A single coiled sea shell seen side on, its ribbed whorls winding in to a fine centre

mono-20008.d: A pufferfish faces the viewer fully inflated, its spotted body a ball of spines round two wide eyes and a pout. It swallows water to treble its size, which settles most arguments before they start.
mono-20008.t: A spotted pufferfish seen head on, fully inflated, a round ball of spines with two big eyes and a pouting mouth

mono-20009.d: A snowy owl sits square on a bare branch, both yellow eyes fixed on you and both feet locked round the wood. It has the calm of a bird that has never once been cold.
mono-20009.t: A snowy owl perched on a bare branch, facing the viewer

mono-20010.d: A golden eagle faces straight out with both wings thrown open, every flight feather drawn in its place. It is the posture of a bird that has seen the coat of arms and intends to keep it. Printed in one ink.
mono-20010.t: A golden eagle facing the viewer with both wings raised and spread wide

mono-20011.d: A kingfisher sits half turned with its crest up and its long straight beak aimed at something only it can see. Somewhere a small fish has just had a very bad idea.
mono-20011.t: A kingfisher in side portrait, crest raised, long dagger beak pointing right

mono-20012.d: A round nest of woven grass and twigs holds five pale eggs, seen from straight above. Someone has clearly been very busy, and is not going to say who.
mono-20012.t: A round woven bird's nest with five eggs, seen from directly above

mono-20013.d: A swallowtail butterfly laid flat with its four wings open and its two long tails trailing below. It has spent its whole life looking this symmetrical and would like some credit for it.
mono-20013.t: A swallowtail butterfly with its wings open, seen from directly above

mono-20014.d: A moth laid flat with its wings open, a furry thorax, a striped abdomen and long trailing hind wings. It came all this way for a light bulb and settled for a shirt.
mono-20014.t: A moth with its four wings open, seen from directly above

mono-20015.d: A dragonfly laid out flat, four wings of fine lace veins on either side of a long segmented body. It has been flying in much this way for three hundred million years and sees no reason to change now.
mono-20015.t: A dragonfly with its four wings spread flat, seen from directly above

mono-20016.d: A bat facing you with its wings stretched to their full span, the membrane pulled taut between long finger bones. It would prefer you saw it at dusk, from a distance.
mono-20016.t: A bat seen from the front with both wings spread wide

mono-20017.d: A grey wolf looks straight out, ears up and ruff full, drawn in fine fur strokes. It has clearly heard about the sheep.
mono-20017.t: A grey wolf head and ruff, front view, looking straight out

mono-20018.d: A male lion looks straight out from a full, flowing mane, drawn in fine ink strokes. The hair took longer than the hunting.
mono-20018.t: A male lion head with full mane, front view, looking straight out

mono-20019.d: A red deer stag faces out under a full set of branching antlers, drawn in fine pen strokes. He grows them fresh every year and still looks smug about it. Printed in one ink.
mono-20019.t: A red deer stag head and neck with two branching antlers, front view

mono-20020.d: A brown bear looks straight out with round ears and a broad muzzle, drawn in fine fur strokes. It has the calm of something that sleeps through winter on purpose. Printed in one ink.
mono-20020.t: A brown bear head and shoulders, front view, looking straight out

mono-20021.d: A Highland bull stares out from under a shaggy fringe between two wide curved horns, drawn in long pen strokes. The hairstyle is entirely deliberate and not up for discussion.
mono-20021.t: A Highland bull head with two long curved horns and a shaggy coat, front view

mono-20022.d: One maple leaf lies flat, five toothed lobes spreading from a single point on its long stalk. Each one is drawn as if it might be needed for a flag.
mono-20022.t: A single five-lobed maple leaf, flat in front view, its veins fanning out from the base of a long straight stalk

mono-20023.d: One fern frond stands straight up its stem, its paired leaflets narrowing evenly to a point. Ferns were here long before flowers and have never seen the need to catch up.
mono-20023.t: A single upright fern frond in front view: one straight stem with paired, finely toothed leaflets tapering to the tip

mono-20024.d: A closed pine cone stands on end, row upon row of woody scales stacked to its tip. It will open them only when the weather is dry enough, which shows more sense than most of us manage.
mono-20024.t: A single closed pine cone standing upright in front view, its woody scales overlapping in neat rows to a pointed tip

mono-20025.d: One globe artichoke stands on its cut stem, the pointed bracts closing in over the heart. It is, strictly speaking, a thistle that never got round to flowering.
mono-20025.t: A single globe artichoke in front view on a short cut stem, its pointed bracts overlapping in rows, a ruff of leaves at the base

mono-20026.d: A sunflower seen head on, its seeds packed in crossing spirals inside a double ring of petals. The spirals follow the Fibonacci numbers, though the sunflower has never been asked to show its working.
mono-20026.t: A single sunflower head seen face on: a round disc of seeds in crossing spirals, ringed by two rows of pointed petals

mono-20027.d: A pomegranate sliced clean through the middle, its crown standing up like a small, slightly surprised hat. Considerably tidier than eating one.
mono-20027.t: A pomegranate cut in half, the open face with its chambers of red flesh and the crown at the top

mono-20028.d: Three fly agarics stand in the grass, caps spotted, gills finely ruled. Lovely to look at and best left exactly there.
mono-20028.t: Three fly agaric mushrooms, two tall and one small, with spotted caps and gills, growing in a tuft of grass

mono-20029.d: A lotus opens in tiers of pointed petals, each ruled from tip to base. It rises out of the mud and still manages to look like this.
mono-20029.t: A lotus in full bloom seen from the front, layered pointed petals on a single stem

mono-20030.d: One rose seen straight on, petals turning inward to a tight spiral at its heart. No thorns were included, which is more than most roses can say.
mono-20030.t: A single rose bloom seen head on, petals spiralling into a tight centre

mono-20031.d: Two lemons hang from a single leafy branch, drawn in the manner of an old botanical plate. Life handed it lemons and it made a print.
mono-20031.t: A lemon branch with two ripe lemons hanging among glossy leaves

mono-20032.d: A lone pyramid of rock and snow rises above the lower ridges, one face lit and one in shadow, fading into the paper at its feet. It has been standing perfectly still for a few million years and shows no sign of getting bored.

mono-20033.d: A still mountain lake holds the reflection of the snowy peaks behind it, framed by dark pines on both shores. The water is perfectly calm, which is more than can be said for anyone who has tried swimming in it.

mono-20034.d: A long wall of flat-topped sandstone cliffs runs into a dry valley dotted with desert scrub. The rock was laid down one thin layer at a time, which is one way to avoid being rushed.

mono-20035.d: A single tall fall drops between walls of dense fern and rock into a misty pool. The water has been taking the same route down for a very long time and sees no reason to change.

mono-20036.d: Tall straight pines stand in rows, the near trunks dark and sharp, the far ones lost in morning fog. Visibility is poor, but the trees have never needed to go anywhere.

mono-20037.d: Three weathered sea stacks stand off a rocky shore with the surf working at their feet. The sea has been carving them for millennia and shows no sign of finishing.
mono-20037.t: Three tall rock sea stacks rising from the sea off a rocky shore, surf around boulders in the foreground

mono-20038.d: A single tall wave curls over into a hollow barrel, its crest breaking into fingers of foam above a rolling sea. Surfers call this ideal, sailors rather less so.
mono-20038.t: One tall curling ocean wave breaking, its hollow barrel and curled foam crest over a rolling sea

mono-20039.d: A windswept pine grows from a heap of rounded boulders in a flat calm sea, with a younger one keeping it company behind. Room for two, no ferry.
mono-20039.t: A small islet of rounded boulders in a calm sea, one tall windswept pine on top and a smaller one behind, reflected in the still water

mono-20040.d: Pale cliffs fall in sheer stepped walls to a flat sea, with a few dark rocks scattered in the shallows. The coastline retreats a little every winter and never asks permission.
mono-20040.t: Pale sheer sea cliffs in stepped layers running down to a calm sea, a scatter of rocks in the shallows

mono-20041.d: A plank hut with a balcony stands on tall stilts above flat water, a jetty at its side and its reflection beneath. Commute: one ladder.
mono-20041.t: A gabled wooden hut with a balcony standing on tall stilts over still water, a jetty beside it and its reflection below

mono-20042.d: The near side of the full moon, its dark seas and pale highlands drawn as a single disc in a fine dot screen. It has shown us exactly this face for four billion years, which is commitment of a kind.
mono-20042.t: The full moon, one disc, front view: the near side with its dark maria, bright highlands and scattered craters

mono-20043.d: Jupiter in banded cloud, lit from one side with its night side falling away into shadow. Eleven times the width of Earth and still mostly weather.
mono-20043.t: The planet Jupiter, one sphere, front view: horizontal cloud belts with swirls and small oval storms, lit from the left

mono-20044.d: A single iceberg stands in flat calm, one face lit and one in shadow, doubled in the water below. Most of it is underwater, as with most things worth knowing about.
mono-20044.t: One tall jagged iceberg in calm sea, front view, its reflection running down into still water

mono-20045.d: A cluster of quartz points rising from its matrix, the tallest a clean six-sided prism. Silicon dioxide, arranged with more patience than anyone has ever had.
mono-20045.t: A cluster of quartz crystals growing from a rough rock base: one tall six-sided point in the middle, smaller points around it

mono-20046.d: A glacier fills its valley in long folded bands of ice, cut by crevasses and walled in by rock. It is moving the whole time, just not in any hurry you would notice.
mono-20046.t: A mountain glacier seen from its foot, a river of ice running up a steep valley between rock ridges towards distant peaks

mono-20047.d: An iron anchor stands upright, its two arms curving out from the crown below a long shank and a pair of stocks. It has never once been the life of the party, which is rather the point.
mono-20047.t: An old iron ship's anchor standing upright, with two curved arms at the crown, a double stock near the top and a ring on its shank

mono-20048.d: An old metal lantern stands on its turned base, the glass held behind slim guard bars beneath a domed cap. It is waiting, with some patience, for somebody to bring a match.
mono-20048.t: An old metal oil lantern with a domed cap and finial, a glass chimney behind turned guard bars, an oil font inside and a broad turned base

mono-20049.d: A tall hourglass stands between a turned cap and base, its sand piled in both bulbs and a thin stream running at the waist. It is the only clock that never needs its batteries changed, only turning over.
mono-20049.t: A tall glass hourglass between a turned wooden cap and base, sand heaped in both bulbs and a thin stream at the waist
